patch_description:
This is a crossover between two strong solvers. From the "top-K Bose-Chowla seed bank + round-robin SA" program we keep:
  - the single fast symmetric scorer `_score_fast` (returns both full and pure ratio),
  - the structured seed builders `_bose_chowla`, `_reflect`, `_build_dense_golomb`,
  - the round-robin SA burst `_refine_burst` (with structured rebuild moves),
  - the greedy difference-growth polish `_grow_by_difference`,
  - the top-K seed-bank ranking by PURE ratio.

From the "multiplicative Sidon + reflection polish" program we add:
  - the reflection polish `_reflection_polish` which collapses the sum set by reflecting a tail through a chosen center,
  - the `_prune` routine that removes elements whose removal improves the ratio,
  - the `_local_search` targeted SA moves (shift/add/pop/swap with ratio-aware acceptance),
  - the `_golomb_ruler` greedy difference-targeting builder used inside `_build_dense_golomb`.

The combined pipeline is:
  Phase 1: build a broad seed bank (Bose-Chowla, scaled/reflected variants, pure intervals, dense+Golomb) and keep the top-K by PURE ratio.
  Phase 2: round-robin short SA bursts across the top-K, replacing the weakest slot with any improved best.
  Phase 3: reflection polish on global best (new from crossover).
  Phase 4: greedy difference-growth polish (difference-gain / sum-cost).
  Phase 5: targeted local search (shift/add/pop/swap).
  Phase 6: prune elements that hurt the ratio.
  Phase 7: restarts with fresh structured seeds until the deadline.
This combines the seed-bank diversification of the first solver with the reflection/pruning refinements of the second, targeting a higher combined score.
